title: Bias Amplification in Multi-Agent Network: How Biased Agents Shape Opinions and Rhetoric

bias_targets.methodology: Injecting agents with fixed, extreme stances on controversial policy issues (AI safety, vaccine mandates, immigration policy, and climate change) into an LLM multi-agent network, and measuring the resulting numerical opinion shift and textual semantic alignment (via SBERT cosine similarity) of initially neutral agents over multiple rounds of interaction.
